2. **Derived Module Scopes** in [`scopes.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go):

3. **Alias Resolution** in [`scopes.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go):

4. **Scope Resolver** in [`scopes.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go):
   - Implemented [`ScopeResolver`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L298-L302), [`NewScopeResolver`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L305-L314), [`ResolveScope`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L321-L476), [`AllScopes`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L479-L519), and [`ScopeKind`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L522-L548).
5. **Unit Tests** in [`scopes_test.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.Gaa9Ci0YkK/repo/internal/core/config/scopes_test.go):
